paper_title: Ultralight vector dark matter search using data from the KAGRA O3GK run
coupling_convention: epsilon_{B-L}^{95%} as plotted: 95% C.L. upper limit on the U(1)_{B-L} gauge coupling constant (dimensionless), lower envelope of MICH and PRCL channel limits
notes: KAGRA O3GK search for U(1)_{B-L} vector DM using auxiliary length channels (MICH, PRCL). This is a genuine new measured 95% CL upper limit (Fig. 5), but the numerical limit curve is only shown in a figure not available here. The text states the best upper limit on epsilon_{B-L} is O(1e-20) over the analyzed band; detectors of this type probe masses ~O(1e-14 - 1e-11) eV (frequency band ~O(10-10^3) Hz). Data points are therefore an approximate flat best-limit estimate over the stated sensitivity range, not digitized figure values — actual limits vary with mass and contain many narrow line artifacts. Limits are several orders of magnitude weaker than Eot-Wash/MICROSCOPE (~1e-24 to 1e-23); paper frames the result as a pipeline demonstration. Local DM density value not stated in the provided text, so left null despite this being a DM search.
